selection.ownership: ApiFlash, founded 2018 by Timothee Jeannin, Saint-Gely-du-Fesc, France. The reviewed edition is the public international API at api.apiflash.com (AWS Lambda), not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official ApiFlash access_key query authentication, GET /v1/urltoimage, GET /v1/urltoimage/quota, error status codes, French operator identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Quota does not capture a screenshot. No qualifying customer-account compromise found in reviewed coverage. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official ApiFlash GET https://api.apiflash.com/v1/urltoimage with access_key query, dedicated quota GET /v1/urltoimage/quota, HTTP 401/402/429 errors, Saint-Gely-du-Fesc France operator, and dated 2026-09-13 incident search. Screenshot metadata HEAD against a caller-supplied URL is omitted. No current unresolved customer-account compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v1/urltoimage/quota rather than a billed screenshot capture. Cached and failed captures do not count against quota; quota itself is a status read.
Native sends Accept: application/json. The pinned source request headers are user-agent only.
Returns raw ApiFlash JSON under data with limit, remaining, and reset.

GET /v1/urltoimage with required url and hardcoded response_type=json matching the pinned source (binary image default is not used). Optional format is forwarded when present. Remaining capture controls from the pinned source are omitted.
This capture consumes screenshot quota on unique successful captures and is not used as healthcheck.
get_screenshot_metadata is omitted because it HEADs a caller-supplied screenshot URL (unbounded host).
